_about: The running story that links the modules. Edit the wording here.
title: Project COX-2
premise: Your lab wants a better anti-inflammatory drug that blocks COX-2, the enzyme that makes the pain and swelling signals. Celecoxib is the known drug. Over five modules you follow one project from a big library of compounds to a candidate whose pose you have tested. Each module hands its result to the next one.

chain.question: Which compounds in a large library might block COX-2?
chain.gives: a shortlist of compounds to look at closely

chain.question: How does a candidate sit in the COX-2 pocket, and is the pose believable?
chain.gives: a candidate with a pose you can defend

chain.question: Could the candidate work as a medicine in the body?
chain.gives: compounds that look absorbable and not too quickly destroyed

chain.question: What else does the drug touch in the cell, and which pathways?
chain.gives: targets and pathways worth testing in the lab

chain.question: Does the docked pose survive when everything moves?

standalone.question: What if the target has no structure at all?
standalone.note: This module stands alone. COX-2 already has a structure, so it teaches the method on a different protein. In a real project it would come before screening.
